column1: # v3.51 — every skip reason a CI run prints, and what somebody decided
# about it. Enforced by scripts/audit_ci_skips.py, which reads the
# SKIPPED lines an actual run produced rather than grepping the source:
# what skips on a laptop and what skips on a runner are different lists,
# and five versions in a row were lost in that gap.
# Keyed on the reason PATTERN, not the test id, so renaming a test does
#   covered-elsewhere  another lane runs it; the note names which
#   deliberate         it should not run here, and the note says why
#   owner-blocked      needs a person; the note names the ask
#   gap                it should run and does not; the note names what
